scope: Google Search Console only, property https://www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com/. Trailing 7-day window 2026-08-19 to 2026-08-26, compared against 99 stored snapshots back to 2026-05-07. Derived strictly from GSC plus the 83-keyword tracker in keywords-master.json. Competitor #1-blocker analysis and AI/LLM visibility are NOT included here and remain manual work — GSC cannot produce them honestly.
wins: "bariatric counselor" is the only tracked term in the #2-3 tier at position 3.5, and it has climbed steadily rather than bounced: 11.0 in early May, 7.5 in early July, 3.5 now. This is the strongest sustained gain in the tracker.
"bariatric counseling near me" posted the largest single-run jump of any tracked term, moving from 31.2 to 5.2 (+26.0 positions) and landing on page 1 with 4 impressions.

"eating disorder treatment san antonio" moved from 22.0 to 10.5 (+11.5) and "food addiction treatment" from 48.6 to 38.6 (+9.9). The San Antonio eating-disorder cluster now has three terms inside the top 13 (10.5, 11.6, 12.6).

The hydration blog post is the site's traffic engine: 4,532 impressions and 18 clicks at average position 7.0 over the 7-day window — 50% of all site impressions and half of all clicks from a single URL.

Two untracked discovery terms are already ranking top-2: "does dehydration cause weight loss" at position 1.7 (29 impressions) and "can dehydration cause weight loss" at position 2.1 (35 impressions). These are unclaimed wins sitting in the discovery feed, not in the tracker.
needs_attention: COVERAGE, STATED AS KEYWORDS: 13 of 83 tracked KEYWORDS show GSC impressions this run; 70 show none. This is a keyword count, not a page count, and it is not a count of unpublished pages. Separately, keywords-master.json maps to 50 DISTINCT target pages, of which 49 point at live www URLs and 1 points at staging — tracker URL hygiene is essentially clean, so the 70 zero-impression keywords are a ranking/demand gap, not a broken-mapping gap.

CTR is the single biggest leak. Page-level totals for the window are 36 clicks on 9,150 impressions — 0.39%. The hydration post alone converts 4,532 impressions into 18 clicks (0.40%) despite sitting at position 7.0, which is far below normal click-through for that position. Impressions are being earned and then thrown away at the SERP.

"bariatric therapist" is the clearest slip and the only one with real depth behind it: position 1.0 in early May, 3.5 in early July, 5.0 last run, 11.0 now — a sustained slide off #1 across three reference points, not a one-day wobble. It is a high-intent commercial term.

Visibility drift is mildly negative but less severe than a first-vs-last read suggests. Single-snapshot first-vs-last is 2,447 impressions @ 14.87 (2026-05-07) versus 1,395 @ 25.95 (2026-08-26). Smoothing over 10 snapshots at each end, impressions fall from 1,958 to 1,625 (about -17%) while average position is flat at 20.34. Treat the flat position, not the alarming single-day figure, as the real trend.

Two pages carry meaningful impressions from deep positions and are wasting them: holistic-weight-loss (298 impressions at position 49.9) and what-is-emotional-eating (133 impressions at position 52.2). Note also that summary.total_clicks/total_impressions (6/1,395) is the query-dimension total and undercounts the true page-level total (36/9,150) roughly 6-7x; the page-level figure is the correct one.
priority_actions: 1. Fix CTR on the hydration post first. It is 50% of site impressions at position 7.0 with 0.40% CTR. Rewrite the title tag and meta description to match the actual top queries it ranks for (dehydration/weight-loss questions), and add a clear internal link and CTA from that post into the matching service page. This is the highest-yield change available and requires no new ranking.

2. Defend and recover "bariatric therapist" (1.0 -> 3.5 -> 5.0 -> 11.0). Audit the target page for content decay and internal-link support, and check whether the "bariatric counselor" page (now 3.5) is cannibalizing it — the two terms are near-synonyms and may be splitting signal. Protect "bariatric counselor" and the San Antonio eating-disorder cluster while doing so.

3. Add the top discovery terms to keywords-master.json — starting with "does dehydration cause weight loss" (1.7), "can dehydration cause weight loss" (2.1), and "bariatric therapist near me" (9.9, 37 impressions). They are ranking now and are invisible to the tracker, which understates real coverage.

4. Triage the 70 zero-impression tracked KEYWORDS rather than assuming they need pages. Split them into (a) terms whose target page is live but not ranking — needs on-page work, and (b) terms that are unrealistic or off-strategy — prune from the tracker. Do NOT infer a publish backlog from this number. If a staging-to-production push list is genuinely needed, confirm it via a staging-vs-prod sitemap diff or Daniel's own notes; the staging site is access-gated and no publish count can be derived from GSC data.

5. On-page refresh for the two deep-position, real-impression pages (holistic-weight-loss at 49.9, emotional-eating at 52.2), and add FAQ schema to the top service and blog pages for rich-result and AI-overview eligibility.
summary: Rankings are improving at the top of the funnel — "bariatric counselor" holds 3.5, "bariatric counseling near me" jumped 26 positions to 5.2, and the San Antonio eating-disorder cluster now has three terms inside the top 13 — but the site converts only 36 clicks from 9,150 impressions (0.39%), so the real problem is CTR, not visibility. Coverage stands at 13 of 83 tracked keywords with impressions; "bariatric therapist" is the one genuine slide, off #1 in May to 11.0 now.
caveats: Most tracked-keyword positions rest on very small impression counts (2 to 27 impressions per term this window). Positions built on a handful of impressions swing day to day and are directional only — do not read a single run's delta as a trend without a matching move in the MoM reference points. GSC-only scope; competitor and AI-visibility sections of the dashboard remain manual.
